description: Meshtastic client for the CardputerZero and Cap LoRa-1262

store.summary: Meshtastic for the Cap LoRa-1262: chat with replies and reactions, DMs, node list, map and a Wi-Fi API
store.description:
A Meshtastic client for the CardputerZero with the Cap LoRa-1262.

- Channel chat and direct messages, with delivery status. Reply to a message, react to it with an emoji, and pick emoji while you write. Messages that arrive while the app is closed are kept.
- Node list with signal, hops, battery, distance and bearing. Traceroute, position requests, favourites, ignore.
- Radar-style map of the nodes around you.
- Settings for region, modem, channels and keys, position, MQTT and more. Add channels from a link or by scanning a QR code with the camera, and share yours as a QR code.
- Community setups (experimental): one-step radio and channel settings for local meshes that use their own, starting with SFNarrow in Spain.

The radio keeps running after you leave the app. Turn on Network access and MeshMonitor, the meshtastic CLI and the phone apps can use it over Wi-Fi on port 4403, several at once.

The app tells you when a newer release is out. It asks GitHub for the latest release number when it starts; this can be turned off under Setup > Updates.

The radio side is the official Meshtastic Linux daemon, so it works with any other Meshtastic device. Needs the Cap LoRa-1262. Power the device off before attaching it.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Meshtastic project.
